shared_elements: animal heads in a row along the top of a register
justification: Both surfaces depict animals in relief arranged in horizontal registers, and both include a row of repeated animal heads/bodies moving in the same direction, which is a generic processional convention rather than a distinctive shared motif. A shows a naturalistic scene of bearded human figures leading horned rams with carefully modelled fleece and curled horns, while B shows highly schematic, flat, abstracted crouching predators, birds and serpentine forms with no human figures and no leading/holding relationship, so the specific iconography and rendering conventions differ entirely.
